name: SolidCraft
description: Models parametric 3D parts in a desktop or browser CAD app with sketches, constraints and a feature timeline, and lets agents design through its built-in MCP server.

skills.name: Run Commands
skills.description: Runs any SolidCraft engine command with JSON parameters, from sketches and extrudes to fillets, or a batch with rollback.

skills.name: Set Parameter
skills.description: Creates or changes a user parameter and recomputes the design, or tries parameter values and reports the effect.

skills.name: Measure
skills.description: Measures bodies for area, bounding box, volume, centre of mass and mass, plus distances and angles between items.

skills.name: Screenshot and Compare
skills.description: Captures a screenshot from a named view or camera and compares the model's outline against a reference picture.

skills.name: Export
skills.description: Exports bodies from the current design to STEP, IGES, 3MF, STL, OBJ or URDF files at a path the agent may write.
